modules.name: Login and Session
modules.notes: Login form with Username, Password, Login. Six demo accounts listed on the page. Errors appear in one alert box above the button.

modules.name: Products
modules.notes: Six product cards, a Sort products dropdown with four options, a side menu, a cart icon, and a product details page at /inventory-item.html?id=N.

modules.name: Cart
modules.notes: Lists the added products with QTY fixed at 1. No quantity editor. Remove per row, Continue Shopping and Checkout buttons.

modules.name: Checkout
modules.notes: Three steps: information form (First Name, Last Name, Zip/Postal Code), overview with Item total, Tax and Total, then the confirmation page.

cases.title: [Smoke] Standard user can log in and land on the Products page
cases.preconditions: The browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com and no user is logged in.
steps: 1) Type the username in the Username field
2) Type the password in the Password field
3) Click Login
cases.expectedResult: The Products page opens at /inventory.html and the page header shows "Products".

cases.title: [Smoke] Products page shows the six products with name and price
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
steps: 1) Look at the product list
2) Count the product cards
3) Read the name and price on each card
cases.expectedResult: Six product cards are shown. Each card has a name, a description, a price and an "Add to cart" button. The first card is "Sauce Labs Backpack" at $29.99.

cases.title: [Smoke] Adding a product updates the cart count and the button becomes Remove
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page, cart is empty.
steps: 1) Click "Add to cart" on the Sauce Labs Backpack card
2) Look at the cart icon in the top bar
3) Look at the button on the Backpack card
cases.expectedResult: The cart icon shows the number 1 and the button on the Backpack card now reads "Remove".

cases.title: [Smoke] Cart page lists the products that were added
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light in the cart.
steps: 1) Click the cart icon in the top bar
2) Read the rows in the cart list
cases.testData: Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99), Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99)
cases.expectedResult: The Your Cart page opens at /cart.html and shows two rows: "Sauce Labs Backpack" $29.99 and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" $9.99, each with QTY 1.

cases.title: [Smoke] An order can be placed from cart to confirmation
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with at least one product in the cart, on the Your Cart page.
steps: 1) Click Checkout
2) Fill in First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code
3) Click Continue
4) Click Finish on the overview page
cases.testData: First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy | Zip: 11511
cases.expectedResult: The confirmation page opens at /checkout-complete.html and shows "Thank you for your order!".

cases.title: Login is blocked when the username is empty
cases.preconditions: On the login page, no user is logged in.
steps: 1) Leave the Username field empty
2) Leave the Password field empty
3) Click Login
cases.expectedResult: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Username is required" is shown.

cases.title: Login is blocked when the password is empty
cases.preconditions: On the login page, no user is logged in.
steps: 1) Type the username in the Username field
2) Leave the Password field empty
3) Click Login
cases.expectedResult: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Password is required" is shown.

cases.title: A wrong password is rejected
cases.preconditions: On the login page, no user is logged in.
steps: 1) Type a valid username
2) Type a password that is not the real one
3) Click Login
cases.expectedResult: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

cases.title: A locked out user cannot log in
cases.preconditions: On the login page. The account locked_out_user exists and is locked.
steps: 1) Type the locked out username
2) Type the correct password
3) Click Login
cases.expectedResult: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown.

cases.title: Logout returns the user to the login page
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user on any page inside the application.
steps: 1) Click the menu button in the top left
2) Click Logout
cases.expectedResult: The login page opens at / and the Username, Password and Login controls are shown again.

cases.title: The Products page cannot be opened by URL while logged out
cases.preconditions: No user is logged in. The browser is on the login page.
steps: 1) Type https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html in the address bar
2) Press Enter
cases.expectedResult: The login page is shown instead of the products, with the message "Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in."

cases.title: The browser Back button after logout does not show the previous page
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user and currently on the order confirmation page.
steps: 1) Open the menu and click Logout
2) Click the browser Back button
cases.expectedResult: The login page stays on screen with the message "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-complete.html' when you are logged in." The previous page content is not shown.

cases.title: Removing the last product from the cart empties it and hides the cart count
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with exactly one product in the cart, on the Your Cart page.
steps: 1) Click Remove on the product row
2) Look at the cart list and the cart icon
cases.expectedResult: The product row disappears, no product rows are left in the cart, and the number on the cart icon is gone.

cases.title: The cart is empty after an order is completed
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user and an order has just been completed.
steps: 1) Look at the cart icon on the confirmation page
2) Click "Back Home"
3) Click the cart icon
cases.expectedResult: The cart icon shows no number and the Your Cart page shows no product rows.

cases.title: Checkout is blocked when First Name is empty
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
steps: 1) Leave all three fields empty
2) Click Continue
cases.expectedResult: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: First Name is required" is shown.

cases.title: Checkout is blocked when Last Name is empty
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
steps: 1) Fill in First Name only
2) Leave Last Name and Zip/Postal Code empty
3) Click Continue
cases.expectedResult: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: Last Name is required" is shown.

cases.title: Checkout is blocked when Zip/Postal Code is empty
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
steps: 1) Fill in First Name and Last Name
2) Leave Zip/Postal Code empty
3) Click Continue
cases.testData: First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy
cases.expectedResult: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown.

cases.title: An order cannot be placed when the cart is empty
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with an empty cart, on the Your Cart page.
steps: 1) Click Checkout
2) Fill in First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code
3) Click Continue
cases.testData: First Name: QA-AUTO-Empty | Last Name: Cart | Zip: 11511
cases.expectedResult: The application stops the user from going further with an empty cart and does not reach the order overview page.

cases.title: The order total is the item total plus tax
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light in the cart.
steps: 1) Click Checkout on the Your Cart page
2) Fill in the three fields and click Continue
3) Read the Item total, Tax and Total lines on the overview page
cases.testData: Backpack $29.99 + Bike Light $9.99 | First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy | Zip: 11511
cases.expectedResult: The overview shows "Item total: $39.98", "Tax: $3.20" and "Total: $43.18".

cases.title: Sorting by Price (low to high) puts the cheapest product first
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
steps: 1) Open the "Sort products" dropdown
2) Choose "Price (low to high)"
3) Read the prices from the first card to the last
cases.expectedResult: The products are ordered $7.99, $9.99, $15.99, $15.99, $29.99, $49.99, with "Sauce Labs Onesie" first and "Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket" last.

cases.title: The chosen sort order stays after the page is refreshed
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user on the Products page with sorting set to Price (low to high).
steps: 1) Refresh the page
2) Read the value shown in the sort dropdown
3) Read the order of the products
cases.expectedResult: The sort dropdown still shows "Price (low to high)" and the cheapest product is still first.

cases.title: The product details page shows the name, price and description of the product opened
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
steps: 1) Click the product name "Sauce Labs Backpack"
2) Read the name, description and price on the page
cases.expectedResult: The page opens at /inventory-item.html?id=4 and shows "Sauce Labs Backpack", its description and the price $29.99, with a Back to products button.

cases.title: Products stay in the cart after the page is refreshed
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with two products in the cart, on the Products page.
steps: 1) Refresh the page
2) Look at the number on the cart icon
cases.testData: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light
cases.expectedResult: The cart icon still shows the number 2.

cases.title: A Zip/Postal Code made only of spaces is rejected
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
steps: 1) Fill in First Name and Last Name
2) Type three spaces in the Zip/Postal Code field
3) Click Continue
cases.testData: First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy | Zip: "   " (three spaces)
cases.expectedResult: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown.

cases.title: The cart icon label is written correctly when there is one product
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with exactly one product in the cart.
steps: 1) Move the focus to the cart icon in the top bar
2) Read the name the screen reader announces for the icon
cases.expectedResult: The cart icon is announced as "Cart, 1 item" — singular, not "1 items".

cases.title: The Dynamic Catalog menu item closes the menu and opens its own page
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
steps: 1) Click the menu button in the top left
2) Click "Dynamic Catalog"
3) Look at the menu and at the page that opens
cases.expectedResult: The side menu closes and a catalog page opens that is different from the All Items list.

cases.title: An empty cart shows a message telling the user it is empty
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with an empty cart.
steps: 1) Click the cart icon
2) Read the content of the cart area
cases.expectedResult: The Your Cart page shows a clear message such as "Your cart is empty" instead of only the QTY and Description headers.

cases.title: The checkout fields have a real label, not only placeholder text
cases.preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
steps: 1) Move the focus into the First Name field
2) Read the name announced for the field
3) Repeat for Last Name and Zip/Postal Code
cases.expectedResult: Each of the three fields is announced with its own label ("First Name", "Last Name", "Zip/Postal Code") that stays visible after the user starts typing.
